home.heading: What is Zen Space?
home.block1: Zen Space is a creative software studio that designs and engineers websites and digital products where clean architecture meets bold visual ideas.
home.block2: Obsessed with motion and detail, we combine GSAP animation, 3D, particles, and effects with solid engineering to build experiences that feel alive without sacrificing performance.
home.block3: Whether you are launching a product or reinventing your brand online, if you value craft and a discerning eye, we should talk.

privacy.name: Privacy
privacy.title: Privacy policy & cookies
privacy.p1: We care about your (and our) privacy. That’s why we don’t use cookies on this website, and we’re not planning to. We’re not interested in tracking visitors or collecting data about you, that’s just not what we do.
privacy.p2: Our only goal is to share our work with you. Nothing more, nothing less.
privacy.p3: That said, our website is hosted by a third-party provider, and they might use their own cookies for things like security or basic site performance. That part is outside of our control, but from our side, we keep things as cookie-free as possible.
privacy.p4: We don't sell food either, but our advice is to eat more vegetables to stay healthy. We also encourage you to support local producers; Argentine yerba mate and malbec are among the wonders of the world.
privacy.p5: Today, imagine it. Tomorrow, ship it.
